Grub2Win has released version 3.0.5.4.

This open-source utility for managing dual-boot configurations across Windows and Linux now includes improved partition scanning and upgraded 7-Zip components to version 26.06.

It remains a lightweight option, occupying approximately 16 MB on the C: drive with additional small EFI modules.
